name: MinimalPOI
description: MinimalPOI is a self-hosted, multi-user map for saving and organising places of interest, with tags, lists, image uploads, backups and an optional route planner with live team collaboration. A FastAPI backend serves the React web UI and stores everything in SQLite.

notes.text: On first visit to http://<IP>:7676 the setup screen asks you to create the admin account.
Google Places / Directions API keys are optional and are set in the app's settings, not at install time.
Behind a reverse proxy, set FORWARDED_ALLOW_IPS in /opt/minimalpoi.env to the proxy's IP and restart the service.
The database, uploaded images and secret.key live in /data. Back up that directory.
